title: Mask-mandate opposition gathering at Tallinn Freedom Square
organizer: Organizers named in report: Andrei Vesterinen and William Koval
participants_original: BNS (hosted by ERR News) ~200; ERR photographer ~300; Yle ~500.
threshold_50_evidence: Three contemporary reports of the matching central Tallinn mask-mandate rally give approximate estimates of 200 (BNS via ERR News), 300 (ERR) and 500 (Yle), all above 50 at one site. Following the manual's lower-estimate approach, the lowest published estimate is used.

start_date.summary: ERR page's embedded timestamp and Yle's publication/body both identify Friday, 27 November 2020.

location.summary: Both reports locate the gathering at Freedom Square in Tallinn.

demands.summary: Both reports identify opposition to Estonian government COVID restrictions and the mask requirement; Yle quotes an organizer saying the mandate violated human rights.

participants.summary: Approximate estimates conflict: BNS ~200, ERR ~300 and Yle ~500. They refer to the same Friday central-Tallinn rally; lower estimate retained for threshold review.

threshold_50.summary: Even the lowest estimate (~200) is above 50 at one site.

protester_violence.summary: Yle reports police said the gathering was peaceful; no protester violence is established.

state_response.summary: Yle's statement that police described the gathering as peaceful does not establish a response action; all response codes remain unknown.

notes: Physical public gathering with domestic government-policy demand. Reports by ERR, BNS (hosted by ERR News), and Yle identify the same Friday 27 November rally; estimates are approximately 200, 300 and 500. The lowest is retained for participant coding. No continuity into December was established by the searches so far; no official baseline match.
open_questions: Check whether adjacent-month searches show a continuous or linked campaign with this event; do not merge separate gatherings without evidence.
End time, consequences and explicit state response remain unknown.
